title: All Those A.I. Note Takers? They're Making Lawyers Nervous
summary: This New York Times article examines how AI-powered note-taking tools are raising concerns among legal professionals regarding attorney-client privilege, confidentiality, liability, and potential ethical violations in law practices.
problem_solved: The article highlights concerns rather than solves problems - it raises awareness about legal risks and ethical implications of using AI note-taking tools in attorney-client interactions.
why_valuable: It provides insight into emerging regulatory and ethical challenges as AI tools rapidly integrate into professional services, particularly in confidentiality-sensitive industries like law.
